item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena ties a stone to a thread to make a simple pendulum for her science project at home. She pulls the stone to one side and lets it swing freely.
Which of these describes one complete oscillation of the pendulum?

options.A: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position.
options.B: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position and returns to the mean position.
options.C: The stone moves from one extreme position to the other extreme position and returns to the starting extreme position.
options.D: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and back to the mean position.
